case: MariaDB Aria nontransactional effects survive failed DML batches
assertions: Aria TRANSACTIONAL=0 direct UPDATE, DELETE and INSERT effects survive failure of the following statement while each batch reports statement index 1.
INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE triggers on InnoDB parents leave their Aria TRANSACTIONAL=0 effects after the parent rows roll back.
scope_limit: This is local source-build evidence for one MariaDB 11 fixture. It does not establish other storage engines, additional side-effect classes, frozen-candidate or installed acceptance.
